nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Deep Cleansing Foam

avis.titre: Reminiscent of Origins Frothy Face Wash in Texture and Smell
avis.texte: If you've ever tried it then you know how amazing it is! I'd say the main different between the two is that this one feels denser. I feel like its going much further than the Origins Cleanser does due to the thicker formulation and tighter spout. I love it! The design is beautiful, the lather is gold standard, and the results are great! My face doesn't feel stripped or dried but 100% cleansed. Love it!
Its very thick and foams really well but it overly dried out my skin. It doesnt feel nice on the skin and has a fishy smell
clean, easy, pleasant, 10/10 would buy again and suggest you do as well
This product feels really rich, thick, and creamy when applying but after I use it, my skin visibly looks dry and patchy. I can see white skin flakes covering my face, and I have very oily skin!

I absolutely love this cleansing foam. It lathers beautifully and leaves my skin feeling clean without that tight, stripped feeling. I have acne-prone and sensitive skin, and this has helped keep my pores looking clearer while still feeling gentle and soothing. A little goes a long way, and it rinses off easily without any residue. My skin feels soft and refreshed.

avis.titre: Great product left my skin refreshed and clean
avis.texte: I received this as part of a free sample program in exchange for writing the review. I very much enjoyed how this felt on my skin. It did a great job on keeping the sebum at bay and my skin/ pores feeling refreshed. It would be definitely something I would recommend to friends and family and I enjoyed how much improvement it left on my skin and pores I am a huge fan of Korean skincare and it is up to par with other products that I have used with other brands and I would also buy it.

Honestly after trying my first K-beauty product (Poremizing Deep Cleansing Foam). I can say that the quality and feel of product is amazing. Firstly, I absolutely adore the packaging and container, so pretty and stylist. And immediately noticed the lack of harsh fragrances when I opened the container. Usually I have to brace for the smell but I was pleasantly surprised. The product was so gentle and clean feeling on my skin, no greasiness or weird feeling. And finally I just wanna say that it made my skin heal up so well, and cleared a lot of my acne and dark spots in around 2 week, I believe the gentleness of the product healed my skin barrier while combating acne. Overall this product is a 100/100, absolutely recommend it!

Really liking this cleanser so far! The Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Deep Cleansing Foam feels gentle but still cleans my skin really well. It foams nicely, doesn't dry me out, and leaves my face feeling fresh and calm. I've also noticed my pores look cleaner over time. Great everyday cleanser especially if you have sensitive or combo skin. Would definitely recommend!

I've been using it for the past three weeks after it was kindly sent to me for free by Skin1004. I use it with two other cleansers I already use and I can already tell my skin loves this cleanser. I use it twice a week and it has never made my oily skin dry or dehydrated. It makes my face clean, smooth, and never irritated. A little goes a long way and it doesn't smell like anything! I haven't gotten any breakouts because of it the past three weeks, so I recommend it if you are looking for a not too harsh cleanser.

I've been using this cleanser for a few weeks, and I really like it. It feels rich and creamy but still gets a deep clean, leaving my skin refreshed without that tight, stripped feeling. I love that it helps control oil, gently exfoliates, and calms my skin. Definitely a new favorite for keeping pores clear and skin balanced!

avis.titre: I found my perfect cleansing foam.
avis.texte: After several days of use, I noticed my skin was calmer and more balanced, especially in the areas where I usually experience redness. The refreshing feeling after washing my face lasts, but without that uncomfortable dryness. In short, the search was worth it. This cleansing foam has become a staple in my daily routine, especially when I want an effective yet gentle cleanse. I would definitely buy it again.

I was surprised by my before andafter photos. You could definitely tell that my pores looked less apparent, and my skin appeared smoother and less dull. I was expecting the cleanser to be drying because of the clay, but my skin felt moisturized instead. I think this cleanser would work well for all skin types because of how creamy and silky it feels. The scent, however, is quite strong and has a herbal, spa-like quality that I'm not used to.

i was sent the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Deep Cleansing Foam from Bzzagent for free in exchange for my honest review. I have sensitive skin, so I'm always cautious with new cleansers. The cleanser has a nice, rich lather and a little goes a long way. I really liked that it left my skin feeling clean without that tight, dry feeling some foaming cleansers can cause. During use, it felt gentle and not irritating at all. However, after continued use, I did experience breakouts, which was disappointing. While it didn't cause immediate redness or stinging, my skin did not react well over time. Overall, I think this cleanser may work well for those who don't have acne-prone or highly reactive skin, but unfortunately it wasn't a good match for my sensitive skin.
Loved! Loved! Loved! Not irritating and your face feels so clean after!

I am thoroughly impressed by this pore cleaner. I struggle with both whiteheads and blackheads and after consistently using this product I have noticed an improvement in my skin and pores overall. Would recommend. I had the opportunity to try the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Deep Cleansing Foam for free thanks to BzzAgent.
I absolutely love this product. Feels so soft on the skin and makes my skin look amazing!
A little goes a long way! It lathered up very nicely in my hands and I felt like it really got all the oil and dirt.

Full disclosure-I received this product for free in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. This is my first time trying any products from this brand, and I was pleasantly surprised! This is an effective cleanser that thoroughly removes all of my makeup, while not drying out my skin. It has a nice feel, and rinses off thoroughly. I would definitely include this cleanser in my nightly regimen in the future!

avis.titre: Makes ur skin smooth and shiny
avis.texte: It's very good product, u only need small amount to make good amount of foam Makes ur skin looks better

This is a luxurious, thick cleanser with almost a paste consistency. You can really feel the foam getting deep into your pores. I think this will work best for me in the warmer months when my skin is oilier. If you have oily skin I definitely recommend trying it out!

This face wash has a very distinct, fresh smell to it that I really enjoyed. Unlike a lot of foaming cleansers, it didn't feel stripping. I wanted to give this cleanser a try because I have several other skin1004 products that I swear by. Unfortunately I think this particular line isn't very compatible with my skin. I noticed small pimples popping up all over my face once I started using it. It's probably fair to say it wouldn't work for me but definitely for someone else!

Thanks Skin1004 for sending the product Madagascar Centella Poremizing Deep Cleansing Foam for free. It is a rich creamy cleanser that gently exfoliates your skin without leaving it irritated or dried. I have a dry skin and it suits my skin. Every time I use it, my skin feels fresh, soft and plump. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a good cleanser.

Lathers super nicely and does an amazing job at cleansing the face without being too drying. Takes all my makeup and products off my face, and helps makes your pores look smaller! Such a gentle exfoliant!

The first day I just massaged it using my hands to see if I had any reaction since my face can be sensitive to new products. After that I began using it with a face sponge. My face feels so clean! I'm happy there's no unnecessary overpowering scent. Love the fact it has an expiration date!
I'm loving my new Centella Deep cleaning foam, it is perfect for my skin type. My face looks clean and rested. I highly recommend it

avis.titre: Bzzz my ladies for Skin1004, Magic!!!🫶🏻✨
avis.texte: Yes, yes! yes! I received this from Bzz agent for free. I love it. I appreciate and I recommend it. 10/10 Its very usefull,cleanes the whole dirt in 1 quick wash.Deep cleaning is a must for healthy skin. Please give it a try and you will know what im talking about ✨

avis.titre: I might not buy it again!
avis.texte: Overall I like the brand but this product makes me skin kinda dry after washing! The scent is okay and the package is cute :)

This Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Deep Cleansing Foam is very good to have. My skin feels super clean and has been a big help . I really like that it is in foam form. I highly recommend it. This is very much worth getting!
This product feels good going on, and leaves your skin feeling great!

This is a nice cleanser. It makes my skin feel soft and moisturized after, doesn't feel tight or anything which is nice. Also a little goes a long way, and I still feel like I get a good clean with it which is nice and I know it'll last a while for me. I definitely recommend to others.

I received the Madagascar Centella Poremizong cleanser for free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I have been using it for 2 weeks now. I want to start with saying I love the feel of the product on my skin. It foams up really well and when I lather it on my face it feels luxurious. The scent is minimal and pleasant. I hate scents so this is a plus for me. My skin feels super clean after using it. Normally I double wash my face at night but I don't feel the need to do that with this cleanser. I highly recommend it and will definitely be buying it again once I run out. I want to try out the other products from this line as well. Everything is reasonable priced. What a win!

I love this product and I'm so glad I got to try this (full size btw) first: the appearance of the package is pretty, light colors and will catch your eye. It looks very soft and feminine. Second: this actually works and did not irritate my face/skin. Lathers well and works deep to clean our pores. Face felt smooth after my shower and cleansing with this.

avis.titre: Great for Oily Skin, Too Dry for Winter Use
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. Thank you Skin1004 for the free product. A little really does go a long way with this cleanser. It lathers beautifully and definitely helps minimize the appearance of pores. That said, it's not the best fit for me in the winter because my skin gets dry, and this cleanser makes it feel even drier. In the summer, though, when my skin leans oily, it could be a great option. The texture feels slightly gritty while rinsing, but that sensation goes away once my face is fully washed. One important note: keep it away from your eyes because it stings a lot. Overall, it's a good product, and if it weren't so drying, it would easily be a 5 star cleanser.

It's a all-in-one facial cleanser infused with Himalayan Pink Salt and Kaolin for deep cleansing It's thick cream paste turns into a rich foam thoroughly washes off sunscreen left overs, dirt and sebum in the pores. Himalayan Pink Salt enriched with 80 minerals clears impurities in pores. Papain (enzyme derived from papaya fruit) and vinegar exfoliate dead skin cells.
I've been loving this cleanser — it leaves my skin soft, hydrated, and clean, and since I have dry skin, I feel like this might truly be my holy-grail product.

I love the packaging, it's very cutesy and luxe. The scent is relaxing, fresh and a bit minty. It's easy to foam up and use on your skin, leaving it feeling clean & refreshed without completely stripping natural oils. Skin also feels a bit tighter after rinsing, without feeling uncomfortable. The first time I used this cleansing foam I found the instructions a bit unclear (what is an "appropriate amount"?) and used way too much, so start with a pea sized amount then work your way up as needed! Definitely don't put it too close to your eyes since it does have this minty scent/feel and it can hurt.
This is a really good cleanser. It does a good job at minimizing your pores. My face looks really smooth afterwards. It doesn't have a strong scent either. I love that.

I've been using the Madagascar Centella Pore-Minimizing Deep Cleansing Foam for a little while now. I can already see my pores looking smaller, which is really encouraging. I think I need a bit more time to see its full potential, but so far I'm happy with the results and it feels gentle on my skin.

If you're looking for a great product to clean your face, this is the one! I personally have dry skin, so I only use it once a week. It's pretty powerful, so if you have combination or oily skin, you'll probably enjoy using it daily. However, my dry skin can only handle it once a week. I like to think of it as a clay mask that really cleans out my pores and leaves my skin looking radiant. Overall, it's a fantastic product!

avis.titre: The Cleanser My Skin Didn't Know It Needed
avis.texte: This cleanser is honestly such a good staple. It gives a deep cleanse without stripping my skin, and the Centella keeps everything calm and balanced. The foam feels soft and luxurious, and you only need a tiny amount for your whole face. After using it consistently, my pores looked tighter and my skin texture felt smoother. . If you like a cleanser that feels gentle but still does something, this is a great pick. I'd definitely repurchase.

I have tested many face washes in the 20 years that I've had acne. This one is very gentle, doesn't dry my skin out, and leaves my skin feeling wonderfully clean. The thick texture becomes a rich lather once it is wet between the hands. It feels very velvety on the skin. I have very sensitive skin and this does not sting or strip the skin barrier. It is paired well after an oil cleanser when washing the face from makeup. My pores look visibly clear and my overall skin has a nice glow.

I received this free from Skin1004 in exchange for my review. This cleanser does a good job at cleaning the skin. It is very foamy. I think it would be better suited for oily skin, because it does feel a bit drying and almost like it is stripping the hydration from my skin. It also has a really unpleasant scent. I don't know how to describe it, but it's not good. If you have oily skin and are not bothered by smells, you might enjoy this.
Very clean cleanser. It stripped my dirt and debris off of my face and it smells nice too.

Love this cleanser! I just started using korean skin care and unsure of the best one. I came across this as sample and never disappoint. Packaging is pretty and the smell is great. It is gentle on skin and cleans really well. I'm excited to use this more often. Not strips away skin and not drying. Best for oily/combination skin. I recommend this! Received this sample as complimentary for my honest review.

I absolutely love this! I've been on the lookout for a different cleanser and this works perfect for my skin! It makes my skin look so nice and smooth and it feels like I get everything out of my skin that needs to go! I highly recommend

I have been using this cleanser for over a week + and my skin never feel like this before! Soft, clean y fresh! Love this cleanser! My pores have been improving, feel like the cleanser is cleaning my pores and making my skin better ! I will recommend it to anyone

avis.titre: A nice clean feeling cleanser, a little goes a long way!
avis.texte: I received this item for free as a part of a promotion in exchange for my honest review. My usual cleaner is hada labo foaming cleanser. I enjoy this cleanser in its stead! So far, a little goes a long way. It comes out as a sort of shiny cream and lathers well. It has a mildly unpleasant smell but its not noticeable if youre not using too much. It seems to clean my skin well, but time will tell further affects. It gives a nice pure clean feeling that isn't too terribly drying. I think a single tube will last a long time, too!

I like the Madagascar Centella foam. The texture is interesting, and it feels really nice on my skin. The scent is a bit strong—though I do have a sensitive sense of smell—but it's not overwhelming. I've been using it for a few days and have noticed some small improvements, especially how much softer my skin feels. I'm considering adding it to my regular routine. Overall, I'd rate it a 6/10.
Feels great on skin and doesn't have a strong floral odor which is better for my skin type overall great product!
